title: Quaint Peppery Ukrainian Onion Skewers
description: A lacto-vegetarian friendly dish featuring caramelized onions, crunchy breadcrumbs, and a hint of pepper, grilled to perfection on skewers.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the sliced onions, breadcrumbs, black pepper, salt, garlic powder, and paprika.
Thread the onion mixture onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the skewers with vegetable oil and grill for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally.
While the skewers are grilling, mix the crumbly feta cheese with chopped fresh parsley in a small bowl.
Once the skewers are cooked, remove them from the grill and sprinkle with the feta cheese mixture.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
Let the skewers cool for a few minutes before serving to allow the flavors to meld together.
